map_selection: structural AND position_registered AND wall_period, as declared in source models.json
point_reveal: second distinct observing-image timestamp in final COLMAP point track; retrospective final-map observation replay, not online SLAM birth
child_cad_alignment_assumption: CAD +Y tube dome direction is displayed as FRD forward; +X is right and +Z up. Dome-to-calibration-forward correspondence is not independently calibrated. Camera/light position swap does not imply rotation.
cad_origin_policy: Nominal design origins placed at estimated position; sensor centres and lever arms uncalibrated
